final: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count FROM account a LEFT JOIN `order` o ON a.account_id = o.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_all FROM order_counts), above_average AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count FROM order_counts oc, overall_avg WHERE oc.order_count > overall_avg.avg_all), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_kept FROM above_average) SELECT aa.account_id, aa.order_count, aa.order_count - oa.avg_all as above_overall_avg, aa.order_count - ka.avg_kept as above_kept_avg FROM above_average aa, overall_avg oa, kept_avg ka ORDER BY above_kept_avg DESC LIMIT 10
